name: Material Design Iconic Font
about: Material Design Iconic Font is a free, open-source icon set with 885 icons designed by MDI Community. From navigation and actions to files, media and communication, it covers everyday UI needs. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under Open Font License.

faqs.q: Are Material Design Iconic Font free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 885 Material Design Iconic Font are open source under the Open Font License license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the Open Font License terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How do I use Material Design Iconic Font in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: How many Material Design Iconic Font are there?
faqs.a: There are 885 icons in the Material Design Iconic Font set, designed by MDI Community. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: Can I change the color and size of Material Design Iconic Font?
faqs.a: Yes. Open any icon, pick a size and color, and the preview updates instantly. SVG, PNG and WebP exports follow your choices, and React snippets recolor through props.

faqs.q: What formats are Material Design Iconic Font available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
